facts.text: Snow left Echo Peak (7,650 ft) and Horse Meadow (8,580 ft) 24 to 26 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Echo Peak
evidence.detail: left April 23; earlier seasons: June 15 (2023), May 17 (2024), May 15 (2025)

evidence.name: Horse Meadow
evidence.detail: left April 27; earlier seasons: June 30 (2023), May 23 (2024), May 14 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Echo Peak (7,650 ft) and Horse Meadow (8,580 ft).

evidence.name: Echo Peak
evidence.detail: 4.0 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 89.7 in (2023), 41.2 in (2024), 41.0 in (2025)

evidence.name: Horse Meadow
evidence.detail: 2.5 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 54.0 in (2023), 22.0 in (2024), 19.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 16 and May 9, carried from the melt-out dates at Echo Peak (7,650 ft) and Horse Meadow (8,580 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Echo Peak
evidence.detail: melted out April 23, 273 ft above the pass; points to March 26 to May 12

evidence.name: Horse Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out April 27, 1,203 ft above the pass; points to March 6 to May 6
